import csv, sys
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

data = []
sample_ids = []
with open("input.tsv", "r") as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f, delimiter="\t")
    headers = next(reader)
    gene_names = headers[1:]
    for row in reader:
        sample_ids.append(row[0])
        data.append([float(x) for x in row[1:]])

X = np.array(data, dtype=np.float64)
print(f"Input matrix: {X.shape[0]} samples x {X.shape[1]} genes", file=sys.stderr)

if np.any(np.isnan(X)):
    print("ERROR: NaN values found in input", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

X_log = np.log10(X + 1.0)
print(f"Log10 transform applied. Range: [{X_log.min():.4f}, {X_log.max():.4f}]", file=sys.stderr)

variances = np.var(X_log, axis=0)
n_zero_var = int(np.sum(variances == 0))
if n_zero_var > 0:
    print(f"WARNING: {n_zero_var} zero-variance features found", file=sys.stderr)

n_components = min(100, X_log.shape[0] - 1, X_log.shape[1])
print(f"Fitting PCA with {n_components} components", file=sys.stderr)

pca = PCA(n_components=n_components)
pca.fit(X_log)

with open("explained_variance.tsv", "w") as f:
    f.write("component\texplained_variance_ratio\n")
    for i, ratio in enumerate(pca.explained_variance_ratio_):
        f.write(f"PC{i+1}\t{ratio}\n")

cumsum = np.cumsum(pca.explained_variance_ratio_)
print(f"PC1: {pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0]*100:.4f}%", file=sys.stderr)
print(f"PC1-5 cumulative: {cumsum[4]*100:.2f}%", file=sys.stderr)
print(f"Total with {n_components} PCs: {cumsum[-1]*100:.2f}%", file=sys.stderr)
print("PCA complete", file=sys.stderr)
'
